description.en: The name of the packaging group.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，列举查询点播打包配置名称包含该关键词的打包配置列表。
description.en: The search keyword. The names of the returned packaging configurations contain the keyword.

description.zh: 分页查询每页大小，默认10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
列表排序，默认 desc：
- desc：按创建时间倒序排序；
- asc：按创建时间正序排序。
description.en:
The sorting order of the packaging configurations based on the time when they were created. Valid values:

- desc (default): descending order.

- asc: ascending order.
